name: HyperSwap 1a/1b/1c ONNX (FaceFusion Labs)
notes: Drop-in replacement for inswapper_128.onnx via ReActor v0.6.2 (released 2026-04-25). Three variants: 1a=speed, 1b=balanced, 1c=quality. Higher identity accuracy than inswapper_128. Already bundled in ReActor update — just swap model filename.

name: ComfyUI-ReActor v0.6.2
notes: New ReActorFaceBoost node, Restore Face Advanced targeting only swapped faces, FACE_MODEL_NAME output, 10x image-analyser speedup for video. v0.7.0 alpha drops Insightface C++ dependency entirely.

name: ComfyUI-ReActor v0.6.2 (same as build_faceswap)
notes: Same update as build_faceswap. HyperSwap 1c can be used for each video frame swap.

name: DreamID-V (ByteDance)
notes: First DiT-based video face swap. Wan2.1-1.3B backbone. SOTA on IDBench-V. ComfyUI node: ComfyUI_JR_DreamID-V v0.4.0 (requires 16 GB VRAM min). Weights: XuGuo699/DreamID-V on HF. Apache-2.0. Video-focused, not a drop-in for still-image MTB.

name: OSDFace (One-Step Diffusion Face Restoration, CVPR 2025)
notes: ~0.1s inference at 512px; surpasses CodeFormer on FID, LPIPS, perceptual quality. VRE+GAN discriminator for identity consistency. No fidelity dial like CodeFormer's w param. No native ComfyUI node — needs wrapper. Also relevant for build_photo_restore.

name: OSDFace (One-Step Diffusion Face Restoration, CVPR 2025)
notes: Same as build_face_restore. Would replace CodeFormer component of photo restore pipeline. Needs ComfyUI wrapper before wiring.

name: CodeFormer++ (arXiv 2510.04410)
notes: Paper only — no public weights or code release found as of 2026-06-08. Deformable registration + cosine triplet loss. Better FID/LPIPS/NIQE than CodeFormer. Watch for code release.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration Challenge Winners
notes: Methods paper (arXiv 2604.10532). 10 winning teams use ensemble methods surpassing CodeFormer. No public standalone weights released. Monitor individual team repos.

name: ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus — maintenance mode
notes: cubiq confirmed maintenance-only mode ~Apr 2025. Functional but no new features. Consider migration plan to PuLID-Flux2 for new identity-preserving work.

name: Stand-In CVPR 2026 (WeChatCV)
notes: Lightweight (1% extra params) plug-in identity-preserving video gen on Wan2.1-14B / Wan2.2-A14B. CVPR 2026 acceptance. ComfyUI preprocessor node: github.com/WeChatCV/Stand-In_Preprocessor_ComfyUI. Full ComfyUI integration pending. Weights: BowenXue/Stand-In on HF.

name: BFS Best Face Swap LoRA for Flux.2-Klein-9B (ilkerzgi)
notes: 11K downloads, 19 likes. Directly targets FLUX.2-klein-9B. Tagged flux-2-klein. High community traction. Evaluate vs current Klein head-swap LoRA for quality.

name: BFS Best Face Swap Klein LoRA collection (attikidd)
notes: Collection of LoRAs for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and Flux.2-Klein-9B. Multiple forks active. Drop-in for Klein 9B face/detail enhancement.

name: flux2-klein-fashion-lora (ebadhussain20)
notes: Created 2026-06-08 (within survey window). 0 downloads — very new. Fashion generation LoRA for Klein 9B. Evaluate garment quality before production use.

name: Ideogram 4.0
notes: 9.3B DiT, flow matching from scratch. 0.97 X-Omni OCR score (best-in-class text rendering). JSON layout/bounding-box control, native 2K, colour-palette control. fp8/nf4/GGUF quants. Non-commercial licence. Day-0 ComfyUI native support. Replaces SDXL for text-heavy/layout-precise tasks. New pipeline — not drop-in.

name: HiDream-O1-Image
notes: MIT licence. Pixel-space UiT (no external VAE). T2I + instruction editing + subject personalisation + storyboard at 2048x2048. BF16 variant updated 2026-06-06. 130K ComfyUI downloads. Qwen3-VL based (arXiv 2605.11061). Needs VRAM profiling — pixel-space differs from latent-diffusion budget.

name: FLUX.1-Kontext-dev (in-context editing)
notes: Unifies T2I + in-context local/global editing, character consistency, style reference, text editing. Active LoRA ecosystem — depth-fusion LoRA (thedeoxen/FLUX.1-Kontext-dev-reference-depth-fusion-LORA, updated 2026-05-27) adds depth conditioning. Needs FluxKontextPipeline nodes.

name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv
notes: KV-cache variant of Klein 9B. Up to 2.5x faster for multi-reference editing. FP8 variant: black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv-fp8. Also relevant for build_klein_batch_variations. Active LoRA ecosystem targeting kv variant.

name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv
notes: Same KV-cache benefit as build_klein_img2img_ref. Particularly useful for batch variation generation where multiple references are compared.

name: VIBE (Visual Instruction Based Editor)
notes: 2B Qwen3-VL guidance + 1.6B Sana1.5 backbone. High source-image consistency, low compute. Strong GEdit/ImgEdit benchmark scores. Public weights unconfirmed as of 2026-06-08 — check arXiv 2601.02242 authors for release.

name: IEAP: Image Editing As Programs
notes: arXiv 2506.04158 (2026-06-04). Decomposes edits into atomic DiT operations via VLM agent. Handles structurally inconsistent edits better than current SOTA. No ComfyUI node. No confirmed public weights. Forward-looking signal.

name: PIXLRelight
notes: PBR + neural renderer relighting (arXiv 2605.18735). More physically accurate than IC-Light v2. No ComfyUI node. Requires PBR renderer pipeline. Monitor for code/weights release.

name: SA-LUT: Spatial Adaptive 4D Look-Up Table
notes: Reference-image-driven spatial 4D LUT; 66.7% LPIPS improvement over 3D LUT baselines; 16 FPS video. ICCV 2025. No ComfyUI node packaged. Enables reference-based colour grading (new capability vs current static .cube files). Code available at github.com/Ry3nG/SA-LUT.

name: SA-LUT (cross-relevance from build_lut)
notes: SA-LUT's reference-image conditioning overlaps with colour-matching use cases. No ComfyUI node. Would add new capability rather than replace current approach.

name: Marigold-Normals v1.1
notes: Current SOTA diffusion surface normal estimator. Same diffusers API as prior versions. 1–4 denoising steps. Drop-in checkpoint swap. Companion depth v1.1 also available.

name: Depth Anything 3 DA3-LARGE-1.1
notes: Unified mono+stereo+multi-view architecture. ICLR 2026. 35.7% camera-pose accuracy gain, 23.6% geometric accuracy gain vs DA2. API surface changed from V2 — test existing DepthAnythingV3 ComfyUI node compatibility. HF collection: depth-anything/depth-anything-3.

name: BiRefNet_dynamic
notes: Handles 256-2304px in a single model vs fixed-resolution BiRefNet-general. SDPA attention (Sept 2025) further reduces memory and speeds inference. Drop-in: same API as BiRefNet-general.

name: DDColor — no 2026 update (stale)
notes: No official DAMO Academy update in 2025-2026. Community forks add UI but no model improvements. Long-term monitoring recommended for successor. No open-source SOTA colorization model found as replacement.

name: SUPIR — maintenance only
notes: Last commit May 13 2026, maintenance only. NTIRE 2026 RAIM Challenge (arXiv 2604.09030) may produce better methods but no standalone drop-in. Flux/SD3-based restoration (12B priors) is the research direction but no production-ready open checkpoint found.

name: Hunyuan3D 3.0 (ComfyUI Partner Node)
notes: 3.4x denser geometry than 2.x (1536^3 resolution ~3.6B voxels). Text/image/sketch/multi-view (2-4 shot) input. Available via ComfyUI Partner Nodes since 2026-02-13. Open-weight HF release status unclear — delivered via partner integration. Advanced 3D decomposition and semantic UV unwrapping as follow-on features.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.5 LATTICE + PBR texture synthesis
notes: LATTICE 10B shape foundation model + PBR multi-view texture. Open-weight on HF at tencent/Hunyuan3D-2 (updated to v2.5). arXiv 2506.16504 (ICCV 2025). PBR output is a new capability. Evaluate node compatibility with existing Hunyuan3D 2.x pipeline.

name: LTX-Video 0.9.8-13B-distilled
notes: Confirmed on HF (2.1K downloads, 29 likes). Step-distilled, generates 30 FPS at 1216x704 faster than realtime. Stepping stone between current v0.9.7 and LTX-2.3. FP8 fits 16 GB. Companion: LTX-Video-ICLoRA-detailer-13b-0.9.8 for detail enhancement.

name: LTX-Video 2.3 (22B DiT + audio integration)
notes: 22B DiT with synchronized audio output in a single model pass. Up to 1216x704 at 30 FPS. fp8 + distilled variants, latent upscalers. Community LoRAs tagged ltxv-2.3 active. HF namespace (Lightricks/LTX-2.3) unconfirmed — verify before wiring. Architecture change requires pipeline refactor.

name: HunyuanVideo-1.5 (SSTA)
notes: 8.3B (down from 13B+). SSTA (Selective and Sliding Tile Attention) — 75% faster at 480p I2V with step-distilled model (8-12 steps). Supports 1080p T2V + I2V. FP8 fits 16 GB. NVFP4 ModelOpt variant (shunyang90/HunyuanVideo-1.5-480p-ModelOpt-NVFP4) for RTX 50-series. ComfyUI repackaged: 3loso3/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged.

name: Mochi-1 — eclipsed, no successor
notes: No Genmo update found in any survey window. Mochi-1 preview remains the only public checkpoint. Quality significantly behind WAN 2.x and HunyuanVideo-1.5. build_mochi_video is a long-term deprecation candidate.

name: CogVideoX-5B — eclipsed, no update
notes: No new base model in June 2026. Most recent activity is safety/DPO LoRAs (May 2026). Eclipsed by WAN 2.2 and HunyuanVideo-1.5 in quality benchmarks. Consider deprecation or replacement with WAN 2.2 as default.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 (BREAKING node changes)
notes: 60% VRAM reduction, 2-3x faster via torch compile + flash attention, GGUF Q4/Q8, improved colour correction (LAB), stream processing for unlimited video length. ICLR 2026. BREAKING: node structure changed — workflows must be rebuilt before deploying. Separate entry from build_seedv2r which has smaller scope of change.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5
notes: Same v2.5 improvements as build_seedvr2_video_upscale but this builder has smaller workflow scope — node change risk is lower. 60% VRAM reduction, 3x faster, GGUF support. Upgrade after build_seedvr2_video_upscale rebuild is validated.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org official node)
notes: Official Comfy-Org node using dedicated RTX Tensor Core hardware. Claimed 30x faster than ESRGAN. Operates on RTX hardware natively (no separate model file). Trade-off: temporal consistency vs ESRGAN's per-frame sharpness. Add as optional upscaler_type in build_video_upscale. Announced at GDC March 2026.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org official node)
notes: Same RTX VSR node as build_video_upscale. For still-image upscaling, RTX VSR is designed for video frames but can process single images — evaluate per-frame quality vs 4x-UltraSharp for stills.

name: WAN 2.7 (MoE, API-only)
notes: 27B total / 14B active MoE DiT. T2V+I2V+FLF+multi-ref (up to 5)+instruction editing+integrated audio. Up to 1080p, 5-15s. ComfyUI Partner Nodes since April 2026. CRITICAL: No Wan-AI/Wan2.7 checkpoint on HF as of 2026-06-08 — API/cloud only currently. Monitor Wan-AI HF org for local checkpoint drop.

name: WAN 2.7 (MoE, API-only)
notes: Same WAN 2.7 as build_wan_video. T2V specifically improved in 2.7. No local HF weights confirmed. Current Wan2.2 T2V remains best local option.

name: Kijai/WanVideo_comfy_nvfp4 (RTX 50-series NVFP4)
notes: NVFP4 format exploits Blackwell native FP4 matrix multiplication on RTX 50-series (incl. RTX 5060 Ti). ~50% VRAM reduction vs FP8. ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper NVFP4 support PR opened 2026-06-03 — still maturing. Test once PR is merged and stable.

name: Kijai/WanVideo_comfy — confirmed current (updated 2026-06-02)
notes: 3.5M downloads, 2356 likes. Modified 2026-06-02 (within survey window — README/metadata). Confirmed as current best Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B ComfyUI package. No breaking changes.

name: FLUX.2-small-decoder (faster VAE decoder for all Flux2/Klein pipelines)
notes: 203K downloads, 143 likes. Drop-in faster VAE decoder for all FLUX.2 pipelines including all Klein-family builders. Reduces decode time. Applies to: build_klein_img2img, build_klein_img2img_ref, build_klein_inpaint, build_klein_refine, build_klein_scene_img2img, build_klein_blend, build_klein_detail, build_klein_face_detail, build_klein_repose, build_klein_headswap, build_klein_batch_variations, build_klein_virtual_tryon, build_klein_auto_inpaint, build_klein_sam3_inpaint, build_klein_generate_object, build_klein_color_match.

name: msrcam/Flux.2_Klein_9B_LoRas (updated 2026-06-07)
notes: Community collection of style/subject LoRAs for FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, updated 2026-06-07 (within survey window). Companion Kontext LoRA collection also active (msrcam/Flux.1_Kontext_LoRas, Jun 7). Drop-in with existing Klein pipeline.

name: facerestore_advanced (flickleafy)
notes: ComfyUI node wrapping CodeFormer + GFPGAN with quality assessment (SSIM, artifact detection, color bleeding, geometric distortion, skin texture, landmark preservation). Automatic model fallback. No new underlying model — smarter wrapping. Low-risk enhancement for face regions in detail_hallucinate workflow.

name: MGFR (Multi-Modal Guided Face Restoration, ICLR 2025 Spotlight)
notes: Attribute text prompts + high-quality reference image + identity info reduce hallucination artifacts. Reface-HQ dataset (21K images). No ComfyUI node. Especially relevant when reference face is available (aligns with build_photobooth). Weights on GitHub.
